sourceIncarnation: Spider: The Video Game (PlayStation, 1997), Dr. Michael Kelly cybernetic spider, default Slasher
observations: Cover establishes an organic furry blue-grey spider, segmented slender legs and a gold/bronze mechanical face implant; it is not a humanoid robot.
Cover crops multiple leg extremities and presents both a firearm and a blade, so the full cover loadout is not the default Slasher.

Gameplay screenshot and extracted frames show a small model mostly from rear or side; legs and the blade attachment remain too small for precise reconstruction. Gameplay lighting makes the body appear brown/grey, unlike the strongly blue cover.

Manual PDF pages 9–10, independently rendered and viewed, confirm that offensive weapons attach to the two front legs, defensive weapons to two rear legs, and Slash is the default returning weapon. A small line illustration shows a side/underside spider but is not a full body turnaround.
missingForVisualApproval: Uncropped source view of all eight complete legs and their attachment geometry.
Readable face/implant and abdomen proportions in the chosen in-game or cover continuity, without mixing the two visual treatments.
Readable default Slasher blade shape, mounting, orientation and side in the chosen source view.
Sufficient native source views to judge the intended atlas angles and animations; hashes and a historical substitute robot cannot supply these missing details.
decision: Do not approve a precise 1:1 4x4 atlas from this evidence. Obtain clearer native body/loadout references first. No old invented robot sprite is an identity authority.
